scope: Free-space allowances per rank that apply when SparkRing lacks exact sizes. A checkpoint revision with a pin manifest is planned from its pinned file sizes, and an image lock that records image_bytes and download_bytes from those sizes. checkpoint_allowance_gib applies to a revision without a pin manifest, image_allowance_gib to an image lock without recorded sizes, and compile_cache_allowance_gib to a compile cache that the deployment's containers have not yet filled. docs/operations/install-reference.md states the evidence for each figure.
